description: Check dependencies before your coding agent installs them: up to 20 packages per call (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems), one decision each: ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK with reasons. Catches hallucinated package names that do not exist (slopsquatting), known malware (OSV malicious-package feed, including versions already removed from the registry), typosquats one typo away from a popular package, critical and high vulnerabilities in the exact version with a safe upgrade, deprecated or yanked versions, brand-new packages, npm install scripts and low usage. npm version ranges are resolved like npm does. Pass packages as strings ("express@4.17.1", "pypi:requests==2.31.0", "cargo:serde") or objects, or paste a package.json or requirements.txt as manifest. Sources: deps.dev, OSV.dev, the registries. Price: $0.004 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"packages":["express@4.17.1","reqeusts","pypi:requests==2.31.0","lodahs"]}.
